function broadcastAdminAnnouncement() {
  if (!canBroadcastAnnouncements()) {
    alert('Broadcasting is available only in Admin View.');
    return;
  }

  const input = document.getElementById('adminAnnouncementText');
  const status = document.getElementById('announcementAdminStatus');
  const message = (input?.value || '').trim();

  if (!message) {
    alert('Please type an announcement first.');
    return;
  }

  const formatted = `📢 ${message}`;

  Storage.set('rotastic_breaking_news_item', formatted);
  sendAnnouncementPushToAll(formatted);
  Storage.setJSON('rotastic_active_announcement_meta', {
    kind: 'admin',
    author: activeUserDocName,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  });

  const history = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_announcement_history', []);
  history.unshift({
    id: 'ann_' + Date.now(),
    author: activeUserDocName,
    message: message,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  });
  Storage.setJSON('rotastic_announcement_history', history.slice(0, 20));
  if (typeof rotasticBackendCreateAnnouncement === 'function') {
    rotasticBackendCreateAnnouncement(message);
  }

  if (input) input.value = '';
  updateAnnouncementCharCount();
  tickerSlotCounter = 0;
  regularTickerDeck = [];
  regularTickerIndex = 0;
  lastRegularTickerWasFact = false;
  checkAndRenderBreakingNews();
  renderAnnouncementHistory();

  if (status) {
    status.className = 'p-3 rounded-xl text-xs bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300';
    status.innerText = 'Announcement broadcast successfully.';
    status.classList.remove('hidden');
  }
}

function clearCurrentAnnouncement() {
  if (!canBroadcastAnnouncements()) {
    alert('Only the rota coordinator and Clinical Lead can clear announcements.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    localStorage.removeItem('rotastic_breaking_news_item');
    localStorage.removeItem('rotastic_active_announcement_meta');
  } catch(e) {}

  if (typeof rotasticBackendClearAnnouncements === 'function') {
    rotasticBackendClearAnnouncements();
  }

  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  if (ticker) ticker.classList.add('hidden');

  const status = document.getElementById('announcementAdminStatus');
  if (status) {
    status.className = 'p-3 rounded-xl text-xs bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300';
    status.innerText = 'Current announcement cleared.';
    status.classList.remove('hidden');
  }
}

function renderAnnouncementHistory() {
  const list = document.getElementById('announcementHistoryList');
  if (!list) return;

  const history = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_announcement_history', []);

  if (!history.length) {
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-[11px] text-slate-500">No announcements have been broadcast yet.</div>';
    return;
  }

  list.innerHTML = history.map(function(item) {
    const dt = new Date(item.createdAt);
    const when = isNaN(dt.getTime())
      ? ''
      : dt.toLocaleString('en-GB', { dateStyle:'medium', timeStyle:'short' });

    return `
      <div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-1">
          <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-300">${item.author}</span>
          <span class="text-[9px] text-slate-500">${when}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="text-xs text-slate-200 leading-relaxed">📢 ${item.message}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

function updateAnnouncementCharCount() {
  const input = document.getElementById('adminAnnouncementText');
  const count = document.getElementById('announcementCharCount');

  if (input && count) {
    count.innerText = input.value.length + '/280';
  }
}

function sanitizeAnnouncementText(item) {
  if (!item) return '';
  return String(item).trim();
}

function getQatarNowParts() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Qatar',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(new Date());

  const map = {};
  parts.forEach(function(p) {
    if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
  });

  return {
    date: `${map.year}-${map.month}-${map.day}`,
    minutes: parseInt(map.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(map.minute, 10)
  };
}

let announcementCarouselTimer = null;
let announcementCarouselIndex = 0;

function buildAnnouncementCarouselItems(item) {
  const history = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_announcement_history', []);
  const activeItems = [];

  if (item) {
    activeItems.push(item);
  }

  // Include recent unique admin announcements if available.
  history.slice().reverse().forEach(function(entry) {
    const text = entry && (entry.text || entry.message || entry.announcement);
    if (text && !activeItems.includes(text)) {
      activeItems.push(String(text).trim());
    }
  });

  // Keep the carousel focused and readable.
  return activeItems.slice(0, 5);
}


function getTickerDisplayDuration(text, minimumMs) {
  const chars = String(text || '').trim().length;

  // Allow comfortable reading time. Short items stay brisk; longer items remain
  // visible for proportionally longer instead of disappearing mid-read.
  const readingMs = chars * 85;
  return Math.max(minimumMs || 6500, Math.min(18000, readingMs));
}

function getQatarNowParts() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Qatar',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',

    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(new Date());

  const map = {};

let announcementCarouselTimer = null;
let announcementCarouselIndex = 0;

function buildAnnouncementCarouselItems(item) {
  const history = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_announcement_history', []);
  const activeItems = [];

  if (item) {
    activeItems.push(item);
  }

  // Include recent unique admin announcements if available.
  history.slice().reverse().forEach(function(entry) {
    const text = entry && (entry.text || entry.message || entry.announcement);
    if (text && !activeItems.includes(text)) {
      activeItems.push(String(text).trim());
    }
  });

  // Keep the carousel focused and readable.
  return activeItems.slice(0, 5);
}


function getTickerDisplayDuration(text, minimumMs) {
  const chars = String(text || '').trim().length;

  // Allow comfortable reading time. Short items stay brisk; longer items remain
  // visible for proportionally longer instead of disappearing mid-read.
  const readingMs = chars * 85;
  return Math.max(minimumMs || 6500, Math.min(18000, readingMs));
}

function playAnnouncementCarousel(items) {
  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  const content = document.getElementById('tickerContent');

  if (!ticker || !content) return;

  if (announcementCarouselTimer) {
    clearTimeout(announcementCarouselTimer);
    announcementCarouselTimer = null;
  }

  if (!items.length) {
    ticker.classList.add('hidden');
    content.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  ticker.classList.remove('hidden');

  const sequence = [];
  items.forEach(function(text) {
    sequence.push({ type: 'announcement', text: text });
    sequence.push({ type: 'center', text: 'Abu Nakhla' });
  });

  if (announcementCarouselIndex >= sequence.length) {
    announcementCarouselIndex = 0;
  }

  const current = sequence[announcementCarouselIndex];

  content.innerHTML = '';

  const slide = document.createElement('div');
  slide.className = 'news-carousel-item';

  if (current.type === 'center') {
    const badge = document.createElement('span');
    badge.className = 'news-center-mark';
    badge.textContent = current.text;
    slide.appendChild(badge);
  } else {
    slide.textContent = current.text;
  }

  content.appendChild(slide);

  requestAnimationFrame(function() {
    slide.classList.add('is-active');
  });

  const carouselDuration = current.type === 'center'
    ? 2200
    : getTickerDisplayDuration(current.text, 6500);

  announcementCarouselTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    announcementCarouselIndex = (announcementCarouselIndex + 1) % sequence.length;
    playAnnouncementCarousel(items);
  }, carouselDuration);
}

      : dt.toLocaleString('en-GB', { dateStyle:'medium', timeStyle:'short' });

    return `
      <div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-1">
          <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-300">${item.author}</span>
          <span class="text-[9px] text-slate-500">${when}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="text-xs text-slate-200 leading-relaxed">📢 ${item.message}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

function updateAnnouncementCharCount() {
  const input = document.getElementById('adminAnnouncementText');
  const count = document.getElementById('announcementCharCount');

  if (input && count) {
    count.innerText = input.value.length + '/280';
  }
}

function sanitizeAnnouncementText(item) {
  if (!item) return '';
  return String(item).trim();
}

function getQatarNowParts() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Qatar',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(new Date());

  const map = {};
  parts.forEach(function(p) {
    if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
  });

  return {
    date: `${map.year}-${map.month}-${map.day}`,
    minutes: parseInt(map.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(map.minute, 10)
  };
}

let announcementCarouselTimer = null;
let announcementCarouselIndex = 0;

function buildAnnouncementCarouselItems(item) {
  const history = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_announcement_history', []);
  const activeItems = [];

  if (item) {
    activeItems.push(item);
  }

  // Include recent unique admin announcements if available.
  history.slice().reverse().forEach(function(entry) {
    const text = entry && (entry.text || entry.message || entry.announcement);
    if (text && !activeItems.includes(text)) {
      activeItems.push(String(text).trim());
    }
  });

  // Keep the carousel focused and readable.
  return activeItems.slice(0, 5);
}


function getTickerDisplayDuration(text, minimumMs) {
  const chars = String(text || '').trim().length;

  // Allow comfortable reading time. Short items stay brisk; longer items remain
  // visible for proportionally longer instead of disappearing mid-read.
  const readingMs = chars * 85;
  return Math.max(minimumMs || 6500, Math.min(18000, readingMs));
}

function playAnnouncementCarousel(items) {
  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  const content = document.getElementById('tickerContent');

  if (!ticker || !content) return;

  if (announcementCarouselTimer) {
    clearTimeout(announcementCarouselTimer);
    announcementCarouselTimer = null;
  }

  if (!items.length) {
    ticker.classList.add('hidden');
    content.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  ticker.classList.remove('hidden');

  const sequence = [];
  items.forEach(function(text) {
    sequence.push({ type: 'announcement', text: text });
    sequence.push({ type: 'center', text: 'Abu Nakhla' });
  });

  if (announcementCarouselIndex >= sequence.length) {
    announcementCarouselIndex = 0;
  }

  const current = sequence[announcementCarouselIndex];

  content.innerHTML = '';

  const slide = document.createElement('div');
  slide.className = 'news-carousel-item';

  if (current.type === 'center') {
    const badge = document.createElement('span');
    badge.className = 'news-center-mark';
    badge.textContent = current.text;
    slide.appendChild(badge);
  } else {
    slide.textContent = current.text;
  }

  content.appendChild(slide);

  requestAnimationFrame(function() {
    slide.classList.add('is-active');
  });

  const carouselDuration = current.type === 'center'
    ? 2200
    : getTickerDisplayDuration(current.text, 6500);

  announcementCarouselTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    announcementCarouselIndex = (announcementCarouselIndex + 1) % sequence.length;
    playAnnouncementCarousel(items);
  }, carouselDuration);
}


function getQatarNowParts() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Qatar',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(new Date());

  const map = {};
  parts.forEach(function(p) {
    if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
  });

  return {
    date: `${map.year}-${map.month}-${map.day}`,
    minutes: parseInt(map.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(map.minute, 10)
  };
}

function hasAffectedShiftEnded(date, shiftLabel) {
  if (!date || !shiftLabel) return false;

  const now = getQatarNowParts();
  const shift = String(shiftLabel).toUpperCase();

  let end = null;

  if (shift.includes('TWILIGHT AM')) {
    end = 16 * 60;
  } else if (shift.includes('TWILIGHT PM')) {
    end = 20 * 60;
  } else if (shift.includes('AM SHIFT')) {
    end = 14 * 60;
  } else if (shift.includes('PM SHIFT')) {
    end = 22 * 60;
  }

  if (end === null) return false;

  if (now.date > date) return true;
  if (now.date < date) return false;

  return now.minutes >= end;
}


let quietTickerIndex = 0;
let abuNakhlaPrayerTimes = null;
let abuNakhlaPrayerFetchDate = null;

function getQatarClock() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Qatar',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(new Date());

  const map = {};
  parts.forEach(function(part) {
    if (part.type !== 'literal') map[part.type] = part.value;
  });

  return {
    isoDate: `${map.year}-${map.month}-${map.day}`,
    apiDate: `${map.day}-${map.month}-${map.year}`,
    minutes: (parseInt(map.hour, 10) * 60) + parseInt(map.minute, 10)
  };
}

function getCurrentShiftPeriod() {
  const now = getQatarClock().minutes;

  if (now >= 7 * 60 && now < 14 * 60) return 'A

'rotastic-admin-view', adminMode);

      el.style.setProperty('display', adminMode ? 'flex' : 'none', 'important');
    });
  }
}

function initializeCriticalNavigationFallbacks() {
  const adminButton = document.getElementById('adminBadgeBtn');
  if (adminButton && adminButton.dataset.recoveryBound !== '1') {
    adminButton.dataset.recoveryBound = '1';
    adminButton.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      // Inline onclick normally handles this. This fallback only runs when
      // the inline handler has failed to change anything.
      setTimeout(function() {
        try {
          const modal = document.getElementById('adminModal');
          if (
            !isAdminViewActive() &&
            !isCurrentUserAdmin() &&
            modal &&
            modal.classList.contains('hidden')
          ) {
            openAdminModal();
          }
        } catch (e) {
          const modal = document.getElementById('adminModal');
          if (modal) modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
      }, 0);
    });
  }

  Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(function(button) {
    return String(button.getAttribute('onclick') || '').indexOf("switchTab('leaveplanner')") !== -1;
  }).forEach(function(button) {
    if (button.dataset.recoveryBound === '1') return;
    button.dataset.recoveryBound = '1';
    button.addEventListener('click', function() {
      setTimeout(function() {
        const planner = document.getElementById('tabLeavePlanner');
        if (planner && planner.classList.contains('hidden')) {
          try { switchTab('leaveplanner'); } catch (e) {
            document.querySelectorAll(
              '#tabSchedule,#tabFeedback,#tabUserSettings,#tabGenerator,#tabAnnouncements,#tabMetrics'
            ).forEach(function(el){ if (el) el.classList.add('hidden'); });
            planner.classList.remove('hidden');
          }
        }
      }, 0);
    });
  });
}


function forcePersonalViewLanding() {
  if (rotasticRotaUserToggled) return;
  if (!activeUserDocName) return;
  if (typeof isDrNabina === 'function' && isDrNabina(activeUserDocName)) return;

  rotasticRotaDisplayMode = 'myshift';
  document.body.classList.add('rotastic-myshift-mode');

  const daySelector = document.getElementById('rotaDaySelector');
  const tools = document.getElementById('rotaSecondaryTools');
  if (daySelector) {
    daySelector.style.display = 'none';
    daySelector.classList.add('hidden');
  }
  if (tools) {
    tools.style.display = 'none';
    tools.classList.add('hidden');
  }

  const container = document.getElementById('scheduleMatrixContainer');
  if (container) {
    const rendered = safeBuildMyShiftMainView();
    if (String(rendered || '').trim()) container.innerHTML = rendered;
  }

  updateRotaViewToggleButton();
}

function ensurePersonalViewHasContent() {
  if (getCurrentRotaDisplayMode() !== 'myshift') return;
  const container = document.getElementById('scheduleMatrixContainer');
  if (!container) return;
  const hasCard = container.querySelector('.personal-poster-card') || container.querySelector('.my-shift-presence-card');
  if (!hasCard || String(container.textContent || '').trim().length < 8) {
    container.innerHTML = safeBuildMyShiftMainView();
  }
  updateRotaChromeVisibility();
}


function rotasticForceOpenSettings() {
  try {
    if (typeof switchTab === 'function') {
      switchTab('settings');
      return;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('ROTASTIC settings tab fallback:', e);
  }

  ['tabSchedule','tabLeavePlanner','tabFeedback','tabGenerator','tabAnnouncements','tabMetrics'].forEach(function(id) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.classList.add('hidden');
  });

  const settings = document.getElementById('tabUserSettings');
  if (settings) {
    settings.classList.remove('hidden');
    settings.style.display = '';
  }

  rotasticActiveTab = 'settings';
  try { updateTickerVisibilityForTab('settings'); } catch (e) {}
}


function runRotasticPublishReadinessAudit() {
  const issues = [];

  try { bindRotasticPrimaryNavigation(); } catch (e) { issues.push('primary navigation bind'); }
  try { initializeCriticalNavigationFallbacks(); } catch (e) { issues.push('critical navigation fallback'); }
  try { rotasticBindCriticalControls(); } catch (e) { issues.push('critical controls'); }
  try { populateInlineDoctorSetupSelect(); } catch (e) { issues.push('inline doctor list'); }
  try { populateSettingsProfileDropdown(); } catch (e) { issues.push('settings profile list'); }

  const inline = document.getElementById('inlineDocSelect');
  if (inline && inline.options.length <= 1 && typeof getDoctorsAlphabetically === 'function') {
    try { populateInlineDoctorSetupSelect(); } catch (e) {}
    if (inline.options.length <= 1) issues.push('inline doctor select empty');
  }

  const week = document.getElementById('plannerWeekSelect');
  if (week) {
    if (week.options.length <= 1 && typeof populatePlannerWeekSelect === 'function') {
      try { populatePlannerWeekSelect(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (week.options.length <= 1) issues.push('planner week options empty');
  }

  ['adminBadgeBtn','rotaZoomBtn','driveTimeBtn','tabSchedule','tabLeavePlanner','tabFeedback','tabUserSettings'].forEach(function(id) {
    if (!document.getElementById(id)) issues.push('missing:' + id);
  });

  try { updateRotaViewToggleButton(); } catch (e) { issues.push('toggle label'); }
  try { updateRotaChromeVisibility(); } catch (e) { issues.push('rota chrome'); }

  window.__rotasticPublishAuditIssues = issues;
  if (issues.length) console.warn('ROTASTIC publish audit issues:', issues);
  else console.info('ROTASTIC publish audit: OK');
  return issues;
}

function runRotasticPublishReadinessAudit() {
  const issues = [];

  try { bindRotasticPrimaryNavigation(); } catch (e) { issues.push('primary navigation bind'); }
  try { initializeCriticalNavigationFallbacks(); } catch (e) { issues.push('critical navigation fallback'); }
  try { rotasticBindCriticalControls(); } catch (e) { issues.push('critical controls'); }
  try { populateInlineDoctorSetupSelect(); } catch (e) { issues.push('inline doctor list'); }
  try { populateSettingsProfileDropdown(); } catch (e) { issues.push('settings profile list'); }

  const inline = document.getElementById('inlineDocSelect');
  if (inline && inline.options.length <= 1 && typeof getDoctorsAlphabetically === 'function') {
    try { populateInlineDoctorSetupSelect(); } catch (e) {}
    if (inline.options.length <= 1) issues.push('inline doctor select empty');
  }

  const week = document.getElementById('plannerWeekSelect');
  if (week) {
    if (week.options.length <= 1 && typeof populatePlannerWeekSelect === 'function') {
      try { populatePlannerWeekSelect(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (week.options.length <= 1) issues.push('planner week options empty');
  }

  ['adminBadgeBtn','rotaZoomBtn','driveTimeBtn','tabSchedule','tabLeavePlanner','tabFeedback','tabUserSettings'].forEach(function(id) {
    if (!document.getElementById(id)) issues.push('missing:' + id);
  });

  try { updateRotaViewToggleButton(); } catch (e) { issues.push('toggle label'); }
  try { updateRotaChromeVisibility(); } catch (e) { issues.push('rota chrome'); }

  window.__rotasticPublishAuditIssues = issues;
  if (issues.length) console.warn('ROTASTIC publish audit issues:', issues);
  else console.info('ROTASTIC publish audit: OK');
  return issues;
}

function rotasticBindCriticalControls() {
  Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button,a')).forEach(function(el) {
    const onclick = String(el.getAttribute('onclick') || '');
    const label = String(el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (
      onclick.indexOf("switchTab('settings')") !== -1 ||
      onclick.indexOf('switchTab("settings")') !== -1 ||
      label === 'settings'
    ) {
      if (el.dataset.rotasticSettingsBound === '1') return;
      el.dataset.rotasticSettingsBound = '1';
      el.addEventListener('click', function() {
        setTimeout(function() {
          const settings = document.getElementById('tabUserSettings');
          if (!settings || settings.classList.contains('hidden')) rotasticForceOpenSettings();
        }, 0);
      });
    }
  });

  const select = document.getElementById('plannerWeekSelect');
  if (select) {
    select.disabled = false;
    select.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
    select.style.position = 'relative';
    select.style.zIndex = '40';

    if (!select.options.length && typeof populatePlannerWeekSelect === 'function') {
      try { populatePlannerWeekSelect(); } catch (e) { console.warn('Planner week populate:', e); }
    }

    if (select.dataset.rotasticWeekBound !== '1') {
      select.dataset.rotasticWeekBound = '1';
      select.addEventListener('change', function() {
        try {
          Storage.set('rotastic_planner_week_start', select.value || '');
          if (typeof renderWeeklyLeavePlanner === 'function') renderWeeklyLeavePlanner();
          else if (typeof renderAnnualLeaveCalendar === 'function') renderAnnualLeaveCalendar();
        } catch (e) { console.warn('Planner week change:', e); }
      });
    }
  }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  [50,300,900,1800].forEach(function(delay) {
    setTimeout(rotasticBindCriticalControls, delay);
  });
  [250,900,2000,3600].forEach(function(delay) {
    setTimeout(runRotasticPublishReadinessAudit, delay);
  });
});

(function initRotasticPullToRefresh(){
  let startY = null;
  let mode = null; // 'down' at top, 'up' at bottom
  let ready = false;
  const threshold = 62;

  function indicator() {
    return document.getElementById('pullRefreshIndicator');
  }

  function atTop() {
    return window.scrollY <= 2;
  }

  function atBottom() {
    return Math.ceil(window.innerHeight + window.scrollY) >= (document.documentElement.scrollHeight - 2);
  }

  function resetPull() {
    startY = null;
    mode = null;
    ready = false;
    const el = indicator();
    if (el) {
      el.classList.remove('show','ready');
      el.textContent = 'Pull to refresh';
    }
  }

  async function performRefresh() {
    const el = indicator();
    if (el) {
      el.classList.add('show');
      el.classList.remove('ready');
      el.textContent = 'Refreshing rota, weather & drive time…';
    }

    try {
      await refreshRotaWithoutAnnouncements();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Rota refresh failed:', e);
    }

    setTimeout(resetPull, 650);
  }

  document.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
    if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') return;
    if (!e.touches || e.touches.length !== 1) return;

    if (atTop()) mode = 'down';
    else if (atBottom()) mode = 'up';
    else mode = null;

    if (!mode) return;

    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    ready = false;
  }, {passive:true});

  document.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
    if (!mode || startY === null || rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') return;
    if (!e.touches || e.touches.length !== 1) return;

    const currentY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    const delta = currentY - startY;

    const distance = mode === 'down' ? delta : -delta;
    if (distance <= 8) return;

    // Prevent native overscroll from swallowing the refresh gesture.
    if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();

    const el = indicator();
    if (!el) return;

    el.classList.add('show');
    ready = distance >= threshold;
    el.classList.toggle('ready', ready);

    if (mode === 'down') {
      el.textContent = ready ? 'Release to refresh' : 'Pull down to refresh';
    } else {
      el.textContent = ready ? 'Release to refresh' : 'Pull up to refresh';
    }
  }, {passive:false});

  document.addEventListener('touchend', function() {
    if (!mode) return;

    if (ready && rotasticActiveTab === 'schedule') {
      performRefresh();
      return;
    }

    resetPull();
  }, {passive:true});

  document.addEventListener('touchcancel', resetPull, {passive:true});
})();

function startRotasticTickerContinuityWatchdog() {
  if (window.__rotasticTickerWatchdog) return;
  window.__rotasticTickerWatchdog = setInterval(function() {
    if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') return;
    if (!profileSetupIsComplete()) return;
    if (rotasticSickTakeoverActive) return;

    const stale = !rotasticTickerLastRenderAt || (Date.now() - rotasticTickerLastRenderAt > 14000);
    const noTimer = !headlineTickerTimer;

    if (stale || noTimer) {
      try {
        if (headlineTickerTimer) {
          clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
          headlineTickerTimer = null;
        }
        Promise.resolve(renderNextTickerSlot()).catch(function(e) {
          console.warn('ROTASTIC ticker watchdog:', e);
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('ROTASTIC ticker watchdog:', e);
      }
    }
  }, 5000);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  startRotasticTickerContinuityWatchdog();
});

  setTimeout(function(){ rotasticInitializeVerifiedRegistration().catch(function(e){ console.warn('ROTASTIC registration bootstrap:',e?.message||e); }); }, 60);
});
